failure.cause: The checkpoint loader reconstructed the selection model on CPU even when state tensors were loaded with map_location=cuda. The deterministic selector passed CUDA batches to the CPU router and PyTorch rejected the mixed-device linear operation.
failure.scientific_interpretation: startup device-placement bug before sample selection; no route set or property was evaluated
failure.corrective_policy: Explicitly move the reconstructed selection model to the frozen selection device, test that migration, and launch unchanged verification semantics in a new r2 directory.

exclusion_policy: Retain the r1 launcher log and exclude it from N2 data. Run all five samples from scratch in r2.
